name: URL Payload Transformation Recipes
principle: Apply one transformation at a time first. Track the stage and decode count. Do not generate all combinations blindly.

recipes.name: outer-query-encode-once
recipes.operation: application/x-www-form-urlencoded serialize the whole URL-valued parameter exactly once
recipes.purpose: Correctly transport reserved characters in the outer HTTP query.

recipes.name: percent-encode-structural-chars
recipes.operation: Percent-encode selected characters (: / @ ? # [ ] \ .) inside the parameter value
recipes.purpose: Test selective decoding/validation differences; apply before outer query serialization.

recipes.name: percent-encode-all-nonalphanumeric
recipes.operation: Percent-encode every non-ASCII-alphanumeric byte using UTF-8

recipes.name: double-percent-encode-selected
recipes.operation: Percent-encode a chosen encoded representation one additional time
recipes.purpose: Test exactly one vs two server-side decoding passes.

recipes.name: unicode-nfc
recipes.operation: Normalize the hostname candidate to Unicode NFC
recipes.purpose: Compare validator and URL parser normalization.

recipes.name: unicode-nfd
recipes.operation: Normalize the hostname candidate to Unicode NFD

recipes.name: unicode-nfkc
recipes.operation: Normalize the hostname candidate to Unicode NFKC
recipes.purpose: Probe compatibility normalization; do not assume the browser applies the same transform.

recipes.name: unicode-uts46-idna
recipes.operation: Generate Unicode U-label and ASCII Punycode A-label for the same tester-controlled IDN
recipes.purpose: Compare IDNA processing while keeping the destination under tester control.

recipes.name: decode-count-matrix
recipes.operation: Run separate cases with 0, 1, and 2 application-level percent-decoding stages where the test harness can model them
recipes.purpose: Identify decoding discrepancies without conflating transport encoding.

recipes.name: runtime-ip-notation
recipes.operation: Generate octal, hex, binary, partial-decimal, DWORD, overflow and IPv4-mapped IPv6 forms from the same controlled IP
recipes.purpose: Test URL parser IP canonicalization; verify destination resolves to the same controlled endpoint.

recipes.name: strip-normalization-characters
recipes.operation: Insert one candidate ignorable character at a time (U+200B, U+2060, U+00AD, U+FEFF)
recipes.purpose: Check whether validator normalization differs from the URL parser; keep each code point as a separate case.

recipes.name: unicode-dot-separators
recipes.operation: Replace ASCII dot with U+3002, U+FF0E or U+FF61 in separate cases
recipes.purpose: Test IDNA dot mapping and validation consistency.
